source.quote: Shanling's own announcement for the M30, read 2026-11-25; the product page /product/393 is image-only. Verbatim: « Digital inputs: Coax / Optical / 2x USB-A / USB-B / USB-C / LAN »; « USB DAC input: XMOS XUF208, up to PCM 32/768 & DSD512 »; « DAC Module: 2x AKM AK4497 + 2x Ti OPA1662 »; « Amplifier Module: 2x ADI ADA4610-2 + 4x Ti BUF634 »; « Tube Output Module: 2x Korg Nutube 6P1 »; « Output mode: Direct/Transistor/Tube »; « Modular Design: 5 Interchangeable Modules »; « Headphone outputs: Balanced 4-pin XLR, 4.4mm, 2.5mm, 3.5PRO / Single-ended 6.35mm, 3.5mm »; « Analog connectivity: RCA and XLR output, RCA input »; « Other functions: Over-the-Air Updates / DSD Upsampling / MQA ». No figure is given for the coaxial or optical inputs.

facts.chip: « DAC Module: 2x AKM AK4497 + 2x Ti OPA1662 », with « Tube Output Module: 2x Korg Nutube 6P1 » and « Output mode: Direct/Transistor/Tube ». USB receiver « XMOS XUF208 ». The maker calls the whole design « Modular Design: 5 Interchangeable Modules », so the converter is replaceable - the same shape as xDuoo's DAC cards, and this `chip` describes what ships.

_la_source_est_une_annonce_ou_un_manuel_: Shanling's product pages are image-only, so every figure comes from the maker's own announcement at /article/NNNNNN or from its manual PDF, both on en.shanling.com. No number was read off an image, and nothing is sourced to store.shanling.com. See the brand file.
_ni_DoP_ni_natif_ne_sont_dits_pour_ce_mo: DoP appears on no Shanling page or manual, and « native » only in the UA dongle manuals and in EM5. Neither is stated for this model.
_le_SEUL_M_dont_le_plafond_dentree_USB_e: « USB DAC input: XMOS XUF208, up to PCM 32/768 & DSD512 » - a separate line from the input list, naming the socket. Fourteen M-series models were read and this is the only one that does it; every other gives one unlabelled Hi-Res figure or none. So inputs.usb carries a real figure here on the maker's own word, while coaxial and optical carry none, and the « 2x USB-A » of the input list are storage.
_DSD_Upsampling_est_du_traitement_PAS_un: « Other functions: Over-the-Air Updates / DSD Upsampling / MQA ». DSD Upsampling converts what arrives into DSD inside the device - which is `pcm_reconverted_to_dsd`, and it is NOT written here because the line is a feature list and does not say whether it is always on, optional, or which inputs it touches. Listed beside firmware updates, it is a menu item, not a signal-path statement. Second device today where this trap appeared, after the EH3's « All-to-DSD processing ».
